2026-10-23FINCustoms TariffOrder Amending the Steel Derivative Goods Surtax Remission Order, No. 1Order Amending the Steel Derivative Goods Surtax Remission Order, No. 1 in order to (1) add 204 products to Schedule 1, which remits surtaxes to any importer in respect of prescribed goods, which have been determined to be in short supply, such as certain chains, fasteners and garage doors; (2) add four products in Schedule 2, which remits surtaxes to any importer on a time-limited basis; (3) end remission for one product (i.e., certain grinding balls); and (4) add 47 products in Schedule 3, which remits surtaxes for specific companies to address exceptional circumstances (e.g., due to pre-existing contractual obligations), such as certain wire ropes, prefabricated buildings and bolts.Registration: SOR/2026-0227 Publication Date: 2026-11-04
subject: Order Amending the Steel Derivative Goods Surtax Remission Order, No. 1
precis: Order Amending the Steel Derivative Goods Surtax Remission Order, No. 1 in order to (1) add 204 products to Schedule 1, which remits surtaxes to any importer in respect of prescribed goods, which have been determined to be in short supply, such as certain chains, fasteners and garage doors; (2) add four products in Schedule 2, which remits surtaxes to any importer on a time-limited basis; (3) end remission for one product (i.e., certain grinding balls); and (4) add 47 products in Schedule 3, which remits surtaxes for specific companies to address exceptional circumstances (e.g., due to pre-existing contractual obligations), such as certain wire ropes, prefabricated buildings and bolts.
